facts.fact: The 2026 finance law (Loi n° 2025-987 of 19 December 2025) appropriates FCFA 4,400,000,000 in section 322 (Finance and Budget) for Microsoft licences and support under the e-GOUV project, funded from domestic revenue.

note: Rise over earlier years is given as a percentage across three unnamed-year span only, so no rose fact.
